prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Which step should a student do in order to be able to repeat an experiment?
A. do the experiment many times
B. keep a record of all procedures
C. make a model of the set-up of the experiment
D. change some of the conditions of the experiment
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
